# Data dictionary: retail sell-out panel (synthetic)

**The data in this repository is synthetic.** It is generated by `scripts/make_synthetic.py` (one seed, default 7) and reproduces the schema, entity structure and — most importantly — the *data defects* of a real licensed sell-out panel of Russian retail chains that the production agent was built on. All chains, manufacturers, brands and SKUs are fictional; geography and the product taxonomy are generic. Figures below are for the default seed. The agent's own company is **NORD** (`VT_OWN_MANUFACTURER`).

Analytical rules that build on this data are in `methodology.md`.

## 1. Source and coverage

- A store-level sell-out panel: what each chain store sold, by SKU and month, in rubles, units and kg/l, plus the chain's purchase cost of the goods sold.
- Period: 01.2024–09.2026, 33 months, monthly grain.
- Volume: 23.8 million fact rows (≈0.67–0.76 million per month), 322.8 bn RUB of sales, 17 chains, 1,588 store IDs (1,542 physical stores), 3,237 SKUs (3,105 with sales).
- Build: `scripts/make_synthetic.py` writes Parquet (`data/parquet/dim`, `data/parquet/fact/month=YYYY-MM`); `scripts/build_db.py` loads it into DuckDB (`data/retail.duckdb`) and builds the marts. `make data` runs both.

## 2. Tables

### fact — sales

Grain: month × store × SKU. Sorted by `sku_id` within each month so that DuckDB zone maps prune product filters.

| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| month | DATE (1st of month) | sales month |
| store_id | INTEGER | store ID (key into `store`) |
| sku_id | INTEGER | SKU ID in the chain's system (key into `sku`) |
| qty | DOUBLE | units sold |
| rub | DOUBLE | sales, RUB (no VAT flag in the data) |
| kg | DOUBLE | sales in kg or litres: `qty × sku.mass` |
| cost | DOUBLE | chain's purchase cost of the goods sold, RUB |

The same product has different `sku_id`s in different chains. To compare a product across chains, group by `sku.sku_name` (normalised name, identical across chains).

### sku — products

3,237 SKU IDs. Source columns plus columns derived in `build_db.py`:

| Column | Meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| sku_id | key, = `fact.sku_id` | 20000004 |
| category_group | product group, level 1 | ^Лицо/Тело/Волосы |
| subgroup | subgroup, level 2 | ^Гигиена волос и кожи головы |
| product_type | product type, level 3 | Шампунь |
| product | «Товар», level 4 (used for competitor segments) | Шампунь |
| manufacturer | manufacturer label assigned by the data vendor | NORD |
| brand | brand | ATELIER PROFESSIONAL |
| subbrand | sub-brand / line | ATELIER PROFESSIONAL Для всей семьи |
| sku_name | normalised SKU name, identical across chains | Шампунь ATELIER PROFESSIONAL Для всей семьи 300мл |
| sku_name_src | SKU name in the chain's system | Шампунь atelier professional для всей семьи 300мл |
| size_text | size as text | 300мл |
| mass | mass/volume of one unit (kg or l) | 0.3 |
| color, country, package, quant | attributes, empty in the synthetic data | |
| article_src, barcode_src | chain's article and barcode, prefixed «Б» and «Ш» | Б20000004 |
| *subgroup_name, group_name* | derived: names without the leading «^» | Гигиена волос и кожи головы |
| *is_kids* | derived: kids subgroup (name contains «Детск») | false |
| *subgroup_base* | derived: subgroup without the «Детская/Детский/…» suffix — pairs adult and kids subgroups | Гигиена волос и кожи головы |
| *in_portal* | derived: one of the reference portal's "Cosmetics" subgroups | true |
| *is_pl* | derived: private label (`manufacturer LIKE 'STM(%'` or brand contains `(PL)`) | false |
| *is_own* | derived: `manufacturer = VT_OWN_MANUFACTURER` | true |

Group and subgroup names start with «^», as in the source; lookups ignore «^» and case.

### store — stores

1,588 store IDs. Source columns plus derived ones:

| Column | Meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| store_id | key, = `fact.store_id` | 1000003 |
| network | chain — the field for any "by chain" breakdown | Гранит |
| client_id | data-source client code; **not** one-to-one with chains | 1 |
| store_code, store_code_in, store_code_src | store codes in different systems | 0100000 |
| format | format: ММ (small store), СМ (supermarket), ГМ (hypermarket), Интернет Магазин (online), РЦ (distribution centre) | ММ |
| format_src | chain's own format code; for Гранит it encodes the banner, otherwise «не указан» | МД |
| district | federal district: ЦФО, ПФО, ЮФО, СЗФО, УФО, СФО, ДФО, СКФО, КФО | ПФО |
| region | region (30 values) | Пермский край |
| city | city (42 values); empty for 40% of stores, see §7 | Пермь г |
| address | address | Пермский край, Пермь г, ул. Синтетическая, 1 |
| kladr | address-register code | |
| rc_supplier | distribution-centre supplier, always «не указан» | |
| *net* | derived: short chain name for answers | Гранит |
| *banner* | derived: Гранит banner from `format_src`; for other chains the short chain name | Маяк у дома |
| *comparable* | derived: one of the 9 chains with full coverage | true |

At query time `app/semantic.py` adds a temp table `store_x` with two more columns: **`store_key`** (one key per physical store: chain + store code; methodology §5.4) and **`city_eff`** (city with the fallbacks of §5.7). There are no store coordinates.

### net_sku — mart: month × SKU × chain × banner × format × district

4.2 million rows. Columns: `month, sku_id, network, banner, format, district, qty, rub, kg, cost, stores`, where `stores` is the number of store IDs with `qty > 0`. Most tools read this mart; they fall back to `fact` only when they need region, city or store-level distinct counts.

### store_sub — mart: month × store × subgroup

0.9 million rows. Columns: `month, store_id, subgroup, rub, qty, skus` (`skus` = SKUs with `qty > 0`). Used for distribution denominators (stores selling a category), SKUs per store, and the per-chain load-completeness check (`semantic.coverage()`).

| Семерочка Х7 | 33 | 01.2024–09.2026 | 33,117 | 500 | 0.87 → 0.89 → 0.92 |
| Нива (сеть) | 33 | 01.2024–09.2026 | 12,043 | 40 (by `store_key`) | 0.95 → 0.91 → 0.91 |
| Перелесок ТД | 33 | 01.2024–09.2026 | 9,583 | 36 | 0.86 → 0.87 → 0.90 |

| Ажур | 33 | 01.2024–09.2026 | 5,731 | 10 | 0.91 → 0.93 → 0.94 |
| ЛАД (сеть) | 33 | 01.2024–09.2026 | 3,822 | 8 (3 in 09.2026) | 0.95 → 0.95 → 1.01 |

| Маятник (сеть) | 3 | 04, 05, 08.2025 | 275 | 30 | — → 0.83 → — |
| Стрижик | 2 | 05–06.2025 | 189 | 25 | — → 0.83 → — |
| Камелия (сеть) | 10 | 03–12.2024 | — | 10 | 0.57 → — → — |

The first nine are the **comparable chains** with full coverage; only they are used for growth (methodology §3.2). Добрый is present in 03–04.2024, 06.2024, 09.2024, 11.2024, 01–02.2025, 04.2025, 07–08.2025, 10.2025, 12.2025 and 02–03.2026.

## 4. Product hierarchy

`category_group` → `subgroup` → `product_type` → `product`: 6 groups, 23 subgroups, 47 product types, 35 products.

| Group | Subgroups | Share of panel sales |
|---|---|---|
| Гигиена медицинская (medical hygiene: paper, nappies, wipes) | 2 | 59.4% |
| Лицо/Тело/Волосы (face, body, hair) | 16 | 40.2% |
| Гигиена рта (oral care, kids) | 1 | 0.2% |
| Декоративная косметика (make-up) | 2 | 0.2% |
| Наборы (gift sets) | 1 | <0.1% |
| Хозтовары (household) | 1 | <0.1% |

Five subgroups have a kids counterpart sharing the same `subgroup_base` (hair hygiene, soap, body hygiene, body care, oral care); methodology §2.4 shows them as adult / kids / total.

The reference portal's "Cosmetics" category (`in_portal`) is 6 subgroups: `^Гигиена волос и кожи головы`, `^Гигиена волос и кожи головы Детская`, `^Мыло`, `^Мыло Детское`, `^Солнцезащитные средства и уход`, `^Солнцезащитные средства и уход Детский`. The last one has no SKUs in the synthetic data.

## 5. Manufacturers and brands

- **NORD** = `manufacturer = 'NORD'`: 23 brands, 7.09 bn RUB over 01.2024–09.2026. Main brands: ATELIER PROFESSIONAL, ГАММА, КОРОЛЕВНА, SILK, VECTOR, VECTOR FUSION, VECTOR ANTI-YELLOW, VECTOR PROWAY, WILD GIRL, SEDUCTEUR (launched 06.2025), FRUIT DRAGONS and others.
- **Not NORD**, though similar: brand NORDAKU (manufacturer SHENZHEN NORD TECHNOLOGY CO.).
- **Competitors**: 27 named fictional manufacturers (PARKER & GRANT, UNIVERA, HELMAN, L'AURELLE, ESTRA LAB, …) plus a long tail of minor brands under 60 "… LLC" manufacturers. L'AURELLE delists two lines (hair care after 12.2025, eye make-up after 09.2025) — a built-in case for factor analysis.
- **Private labels**: manufacturer `STM(<chain>)`, brand suffixed `(PL)`; each brand is sold only in its own chain. 7 manufacturers (STM(GRANIT), STM(X7), STM(NIVA), STM(AZHUR), STM(DEPO), STM(LAD), STM(DETSKIY OSTROV)), 11 brands, 4.16 bn RUB (1.3% of the panel). STM(X7) owns brands of both Семерочка Х7 and Перелесок ТД.
- **`manufacturer = 'не указан'`** (not specified): 73 brands, 3.23 bn RUB (1.0% of the panel). The manufacturer is unknown; the brand is known — except for brand «.» (see §7).
- One brand can have several labels: МЕГАДРАКОНЫ / MEGADRAGONS, COLORIA / КОЛОРИЯ.

## 6. Derived metrics

| Metric | Formula | Where meaningful |
|---|---|---|
| Average retail price, RUB/unit | sum(rub) / sum(qty) | at SKU level; above it depends on the assortment |
| Average purchase price, RUB/unit | sum(cost) / sum(qty) | at SKU level within one chain |
| Chain markup | (sum(rub) − sum(cost)) / sum(cost) | within one chain and one year; methodology §7 |
| Stores (numeric distribution) | count(DISTINCT store_key) with qty > 0 in the period | by chain / region |
| Store share | stores selling the brand / chain stores selling the category | |
| Sales per store per month | sum(rub) / sum of monthly stores with sales | |
| SKUs per store | count(DISTINCT sku_name) per store, averaged over stores | |
| Market share | object's sum(rub) / category's sum(rub) in the same chains, months and regions | |

## 7. Known data defects

These defects are deliberately reproduced from the real panel; the methodology layer handles each of them.

| Defect | Scale in the synthetic data | How the agent handles it |
|---|---|---|
| Incomplete month: ЛАД 09.2026 | 3 stores with sales instead of the usual 8; revenue 46% of the usual level | Excluded from year-over-year comparisons on both sides; caveat in shares (methodology §3.7) |
| Incomplete month: Гиперкосмос 09.2026 | all 4 stores report, but each at ~60% of its August revenue — part of the month loaded | Same |
| Incomplete month: Офис Х7 07.2026 | flagged by the same completeness rule; the chain is not used anyway | Not comparable, outside every default calculation |
| One store under several `store_id`s | Нива 06–08.2026 (30 of 40 stores), Детский Остров 2024 (12 of 50), ЛАД 05.2025 (4 of 8): same store code and address, new ID for those months. Over 01–09.2026 Нива has 70 store IDs for 40 stores | Stores are counted by `store_key` = chain + store code (`store_x`) |
| «Маяк прочие» | Гранит stores without a format code: 0 in 01–02.2024 → 140 in 09.2026; assortment profile like Маяк у дома | Separate banner row with a caveat (methodology §5.6) |
| Empty city | 40% of stores (642 of 1,588), including all of Moscow, St Petersburg, Sevastopol | `city_eff`: city-region for the three federal cities, otherwise «город не указан (<region>)» |
| Brand «.» with manufacturer «не указан» | 30 SKUs, 914 mln RUB in 10.2025–09.2026 (0.7% of the panel) | Counted in totals and shares; not shown as a ranking row; reported as "without a brand label" |
| Zero cost at Депо from 01.2025 | `cost = 0` for every row from 2025 | Purchase price and markup for Депо are not computed from 2025 |
| Cost-ratio drift across chains and years | Гранит 0.86 → 0.98, Детский Остров 0.84 → 0.71; cost above revenue at Депо 2024, ЛАД 2026, Запас 2026 | Markup only within one chain and year, with a caveat (methodology §7) |
| Chains with partial coverage | 8 chains: a few months only, gaps (Добрый), stopped reporting (Запас 02.2026, Офис Х7 08.2026) | Growth only on the 9 comparable chains; partial chains listed in «Ограничения» |
